pages.text: Past uranium, elements get heavier and shorter-lived - until, theory says, an island: nuclei with $(thing)magic numbers$() of protons and neutrons, closed shells that hold them together.

The $(item)Nuclide Forge$() fires heavy ions from the r-process into a target. $(item)Flerovium$() (element 114) first, then $(item)Unbihexium$() (126), the heart of the island. Hypernova Alloy and Transcendent Metal now need them.
Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons.$(br2)Made in $(item)Nuclide Forge$().
Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long.$(br2)Made in $(item)Nuclide Forge$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Flerovium Ingot$(): Dimensional Residue, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Unbihexium Ingot$(li)$(item)Unbihexium Ingot$(): Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Panspermia Seed
